Which statement about potassium fluoride is correct?
A
It can conduct electricity when it is solid.
B
It dissolves in water.
C
It has a low melting point.
D
It is a molecule.

options.label: A
options.text: It can conduct electricity when it is solid.

options.label: C
options.text: It has a low melting point.
